title: Saudi Arabian Asparagus and Pilaf Delight
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish inspired by the traditional cuisine of Saudi Arabia, featuring tender asparagus and a fragrant pilaf.

ingredients.name: arabian spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern grocery stores

ingredients.name: creamy
ingredients.notes: sour cream or plain Greek yogurt

instructions: Heat the ghee or oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the pilaf and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly toasted and fragrant, about 5 minutes.
Add the asparagus to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 5-7 minutes.
Stir in the Arabian spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the creamy and cook for an additional minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the asparagus and pilaf mixture hot, garnished with additional Arabian spice blend if desired.
Optional: Add cooked chicken or beef to the pilaf for added protein.
